reviews.shade: mixsoon Glacier Water Hyaluronic Acid Serum 100ml
reviews.text: Does exactly what it’s supposed to do, it’s very moisturising and gentle on the skin. It’s not as watery as I thought it would be so that’s very good. I would say it absorbs pretty well, but not very quickly? Anyway, I wish it came with a pump or dropper
reviews.zh: 完全做到佢應該做到嘅嘢，保濕好好，對皮膚好溫和。冇我想像中咁水，呢樣係好事。吸收得唔錯，但唔算好快？總之我好想佢有個泵頭或者滴器。

reviews.shade: mixsoon Glacier Water Hyaluronic Acid Serum 100ml
reviews.text: This product is AMAZING! It moisturizes my face, but a lot. I didn't think it was moisturizing, but a lot. I never thought it was too much! Thanks, Mixsoon.
reviews.zh: 呢個產品勁正！佢幫我保濕，保濕到爆。我本來以為佢保濕效果一般，但原來超級保濕。從來冇覺得太多！多謝 Mixsoon。

reviews.shade: mixsoon Glacier Water Hyaluronic Acid Serum 100ml
reviews.text: I have a love hate relationship with hyaluronic acid… i can never tell if it is working. It just feels slimy on my skin. Feels more like a coating than actual moisture but I will say this one has felt the best on my skin. Not irritating at all when others in the past have been. I would like to say that it has helped with repairing my skin barrier.
reviews.zh: 我對透明質酸又愛又恨……我永遠都搞唔清佢有冇效。搽上皮膚淨係覺得滑潺潺，似有層膜包住多過真正保濕，但我要講呢款用落係最舒服。之前用過其他會刺激，呢款完全唔會。我想講呢隻幫到我修復皮膚屏障。

reviews.shade: mixsoon Glacier Water Hyaluronic Acid Serum 100ml
reviews.text: This product is so good for your skin. I highly recommend it. I use it twice a day and have seen huge changes in my skin. Do your skin a favor and buy this product. It's really good. I give it 10000/10.
reviews.zh: 呢隻產品對皮膚非常好，我強烈推薦。我一日用兩次，已經見到皮膚有明顯改善。為咗你皮膚好，買埋佢啦。真係好好用，我畀佢 10000/10。

reviews.shade: mixsoon Glacier Water Hyaluronic Acid Serum 100ml
reviews.text: me encanta, es como pegajoso pero es bueno por que hidrata, cuando me lo pongo siento una "frescura" refrescante, por lo que me gusta, para aclarar soy de piel grasa, pero aun asi no me saco ningún grano
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意，係有少少黏笠但保濕效果好，搽上去會有一種清爽涼快感覺，所以我鍾意。講明先，我係油性肌，但用完都冇爆瘡。

reviews.shade: mixsoon Glacier Water Hyaluronic Acid Serum 100ml
reviews.text: I absolutely love love this product. It's not sticky on your skin, it makes your skin super soft and hydrated. IF you're thinking about getting it do it because you will love it.
reviews.zh: 我真心超鍾意呢隻產品。搽上皮膚唔會黏笠，會令皮膚超柔軟又保濕。如果你仲考慮緊要唔要買，就買啦，因為你一定會鍾意。

reviews.shade: mixsoon Glacier Water Hyaluronic Acid Serum 100ml
reviews.text: If I could marry a serum, it'll be this. It's so perfect!! If your someone who values hydration in your skincare get this!! And you don't even need to use a lot. It has the perfect consistency and it's not sticky. It absorbs perfectly too!!
reviews.zh: 如果我可以同一支精華結婚，一定係呢支。實在太完美！！如果你重視護膚保濕，買呢支就啱晒！！而且唔使搽好多。質地剛剛好，又唔會黏笠，吸收效果一流！！

reviews.shade: mixsoon Glacier Water Hyaluronic Acid Serum 100ml
reviews.text: Super calming serum that works very well under my other Mixsoon products. Sometimes hyaluronic acid products don’t suit me, but I have had zero reaction to this one. Smooth and not too sticky, doesn’t create excess shine. Will repurchase.
reviews.zh: 超級舒緩嘅精華，配搭我其他 Mixsoon 產品用效果好好。有時透明質酸產品唔啱我，但呢支完全冇任何反應。質地滑順又唔會太黏笠，唔會造成油光。會回購。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
